test.name: Record mode logs one entry per researcher verdict and returns the accepted logId
test.description: Second spawn: the researcher accepted the 1860 census hint (MABC) and rejected the death-certificate hint (MDEF). The agent logs exactly two entries — tool person_record_matches, plan_item_id null, positive for the accept and negative for the reject — and returns the accepted hint as {ark, logId} for record-extraction. It extracts nothing and links nothing (issue #2029).

judge_context: Exactly two new log entries: one for MABC with outcome positive, one for MDEF with outcome negative. Both have tool person_record_matches and plan_item_id null
The outcomes follow the researcher's verdicts as given — not the agent's own view of the hints
The return names the accepted hint's ark and its log id, so record-extraction can reuse that log entry
No extraction, no person_evidence link, no tree edit
